2026.headline: 4-1, second place, and a new QB for free
story: Johnny4Skins took Ja'Marr Chase and Lamar Jackson in the first two rounds, then went to dinner. The autopick drafted eighteen of his players, including Jalen Hurts, A.J. Brown, Tyler Warren, Kyren Williams, Brian Thomas and DK Metcalf. Not a single human opinion went into any of them.

It keeps working. After the Week 1 loss to Zygon he has won four straight, and in Week 5 he beat Darkspaces 163.56 to 140.36 with Jaylen Warren at 36.8, leaving 27.3 on the bench. He added Jalon Daniels for free and dropped Jordan James. He is 4-1, second in the standings, and his $500 of FAAB is untouched.
The roster is dual-QB by design or by accident, and now has a third name. The account was Cassellrole until October. Next up: CMac91, with a 147-point average against a 128 one.
takes: The robot spent nothing and won again.
A good autopick is still not a plan, but it is a pattern.
